page.index.meta.title: KeyBio · It knows you by the way you type
page.index.meta.description: KeyBio recognises people by the way they type. Try it in your browser, find out how it works and download the program for Windows, macOS and Linux.
page.index.meta.ogDescription: Keystroke dynamics biometrics. Try it in your browser: your keystrokes never leave your device.
page.index.hero.title: It knows you by the way you type.
page.index.hero.lead: KeyBio measures how long you hold down each key, how long you take to move on to the next one and which key combinations slow you down. That is enough to tell one person from another, with no passwords or cameras.
page.index.hero.note: The demo runs entirely in your browser: your keystrokes are never sent anywhere.
page.index.timing.title: What KeyBio measures when you type “ho”
page.index.timing.desc: The H key is held down for 95 milliseconds. 40 milliseconds pass between releasing it and pressing the O. 135 milliseconds pass between the two key presses.
page.index.timing.caption: When you type “ho”, KeyBio records when you press and release each key. Everyone has their own timing.
page.index.demo.title: Try it in your browser
page.index.demo.lead: Create your typing fingerprint by typing two short sentences and see whether KeyBio recognises you. If there are several of you, each person can enrol on this computer to play “guess who”.
page.index.how.title: It's not what you type, it's how
page.index.how.lead: The way you type is as personal as your handwriting. KeyBio turns it into a fingerprint and compares it with those of the people who have enrolled.
page.index.how.step1.title: 1. Capture
page.index.how.step1.text: It records the moment you press and release each key. It does not keep a recording of what you type to read it: it is only interested in the timing.
page.index.how.step2.title: 2. Features
page.index.how.step2.text: It calculates more than twenty features: how long you hold each key, flight time, the speed of each pair and trio of letters, how you use capital letters and how you correct mistakes.
page.index.how.step3.title: 3. Comparison
page.index.how.step3.text: It compares your sample with each fingerprint: which combinations are your fastest and slowest (R measure), how many take the same time (A measure) and how far apart your overall features are.
page.index.how.step4.title: 4. Personal threshold
page.index.how.step4.text: Each person has their own threshold, calculated by comparing their samples with each other. If no fingerprint is similar enough, the answer is “not enrolled”.
page.index.features.title: What the program includes
page.index.features.1: Identification (who am I?) and verification (am I this person?), also with free text.
page.index.features.2: Live estimate while you type and a feature-by-feature explanation of the result.
page.index.features.3: Profiles that adapt with use and automatic calibration with your own data.
page.index.features.4: Impersonation detection: automated typing and replayed recordings.
page.index.features.5: Dashboard, history, heat maps and PDF reports.
page.index.data.title: Your data is yours
page.index.data.text: The program keeps everything on your own computer, optionally encrypted with a password, and sends nothing over the internet. Neither does the demo on this page: everything is calculated in your browser.
page.index.limits.title: How far it goes
page.index.limits.text: In a test with 20 simulated people (computer-generated typing) and 30 strangers, on “normal” sensitivity, it recognised the right person in 79 out of 80 attempts and rejected 29 of the 30 strangers. This is simulated data: with real people the results may be worse, so take it as a guide, not a guarantee.
page.index.download.title: Take KeyBio to your computer
page.index.download.lead: The full program works offline and does not need anything else installed.
page.index.download.soon: Downloads will be available very soon.
page.index.download.windows.note: As the program is not digitally signed yet, Windows may show a SmartScreen warning: click “More info” and then “Run anyway”.
page.index.download.mac.req: Macs with Apple Silicon (M1 or later), macOS 11 or later.
page.index.download.mac.note: Drag KeyBio to Applications. As it is not signed by Apple yet, the first time open it with right-click → Open.
page.index.download.linux.note: The .deb installs with a double click. For the .tar.gz, extract it and run KeyBio/instalar.sh. Either way, KeyBio appears in your applications menu.
page.index.reviews.title: What did you think?
page.index.reviews.lead: Your rating helps to improve KeyBio. Comments are published after they have been reviewed.
page.index.reviews.accept: By sending it you accept the privacy policy.

page.privacy.meta.title: Privacy and legal notice · KeyBio
page.privacy.meta.description: What data the KeyBio website processes, why, and how to exercise your rights.
page.privacy.translation: This translation is provided for convenience. If there is any discrepancy, the Spanish version prevails.
page.privacy.controller.title: Data controller
page.privacy.controller.text: This website and the KeyBio program are a personal project by . For any question about your data you can write through the contact form.
page.privacy.demo.title: The demo does not send your keystrokes
page.privacy.demo.text: The way you type is biometric data, so the demo is designed not to collect it: the timing of your keystrokes is processed in your browser and stored only there (local storage), so that you can come back to the demo later. It is never sent to this website or to third parties. You can delete it at any time with the “Delete all data” button in the demo or by clearing the site data in your browser.
page.privacy.data.title: What data is processed
page.privacy.data.ratings: Ratings: the stars and, if you write them, a name and a comment. To prevent abuse, an encrypted fingerprint (HMAC) of your IP address is stored, not the IP itself; it is only used to limit ratings to one per day. The anti-spam check is done by Cloudflare Turnstile.
page.privacy.data.contact: Contact: your name, your email address and your message, which are forwarded by email through the Web3Forms service so that I can reply to you.
page.privacy.data.preferences: Preferences: the light or dark theme and the language you choose are stored in your browser.
page.privacy.data.noTracking: The website does not use advertising or tracking cookies, or analytics tools.
page.privacy.purposes.title: Purposes and legal basis
page.privacy.purposes.ratings: Publishing the ratings and the website's average, with your consent when you send them.
page.privacy.purposes.contact: Replying to your messages, with your consent when you send the form.
page.privacy.purposes.abuse: Protecting the website against spam and abuse (legitimate interest).
page.privacy.retention.title: How long it is kept
page.privacy.retention.text: Ratings are kept while the website is active or until you ask for them to be deleted. Contact messages, for as long as needed to deal with them.
page.privacy.providers.title: Service providers
page.privacy.providers.cloudflare: Cloudflare: website hosting, the ratings database (stored in the European Union) and anti-spam check (Turnstile).
page.privacy.providers.web3forms: Web3Forms: forwarding contact form messages to the owner's email.
page.privacy.providers.hcaptcha: hCaptcha (Intuition Machines): anti-spam check on the contact form. It only loads when you start typing in it.
page.privacy.providers.transfers: These providers may process data outside the European Economic Area with the safeguards provided for in the General Data Protection Regulation.
page.privacy.rights.title: Your rights
page.privacy.rights.text: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, object to its processing or withdraw your consent by writing through the contact form. If you believe your rights have not been respected, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) or to the data protection authority in your country.
page.privacy.program.title: The downloadable program
page.privacy.program.text: KeyBio keeps profiles and history only on the computer where it is installed (optionally encrypted with a password) and does not send data over the internet. If you use it with other people, ask for their permission before enrolling the way they type.
page.privacy.ip.title: Intellectual property
page.privacy.ip.text: All rights reserved. The program can be downloaded and used free of charge; copying, modifying or redistributing its code or its executables without permission is not allowed.

enroll: This morning I went for a run in the park. It was cold, but the sun was already warm and lots of people were out walking their dogs.
My grandmother keeps her recipes in an old tin box. Some are handwritten in tiny letters, and most have stains of oil and flour on them.
The number twelve bus comes every fifteen minutes. If you miss it, walk down to the square and take the underground into the city centre.
To build the bookshelf you only need a screwdriver. First fit the sides, then the shelves and, finally, tighten all the screws properly.
On Sunday evenings we watch a film at home. Someone different chooses each week, so sometimes it is a comedy and sometimes science fiction.
Our team won the match in the very last minute. Lucy scored a header after a corner and the whole stadium stood up to celebrate it.
verify: Yesterday I found an old bookshop on a narrow street. The owner recommended an adventure novel, and I bought it without a second thought.
When it rains, the cat climbs onto the windowsill and watches the drops for hours. Then it falls asleep on the sofa, on the checked blanket.
In summer we visit my cousins in the village. At night we go out to the square, play cards and eat ice cream until very late.
The science museum has a room with a huge pendulum. Children stand there watching it slowly change direction throughout the day.
